basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Only Indian citizens who live in Uttar Pradesh can apply for this 1 Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post. The post is in the Department of Electronics Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi, in a project sponsored by the Council of Science & Technology U. P. (CSTUP). The project is sanctioned for up to two years (2025-27), and the pay is a fixed Rs. 28,000/- per month. You need a First Class B.E/B.Tech or M.Sc. in the fields the notice names. Send your application by email to [email protected] within 21 days of the advertisement.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years on 1 April 2026. It is relaxable as per GoI Rules. The notice prints no minimum age.

qualification.details: B.E/B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied branches with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade), OR M.Sc. in Electronics, Physics, or allied areas with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade). Candidates with M.Tech or higher qualifications in the relevant discipline will also be considered.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form attached to the notification (page 2 of the PDF).
Put the filled form and all your supporting documents together in one PDF file.
Use this exact subject line: Application for R&D/SA/CSTUP/ECE/25-26/772
Send it within 21 days of the advertisement. You do not need to send a hard copy.
For more information about the project, the notice gives this page: https://iitbhu.ac.in/dept/ece/people/prmuduliece
Caste certificate (the form says a certificate must be attached if you are OBC/SC/ST)
Personal details: name, father's name, mother's name, e-mail, phone number, date of birth, category (GN / OBC / SC / ST), permanent address and correspondence address.
Education: for 10th, 12th, B.Tech./B.E./B.Sc., M.Sc. and others, the university/board, year of passing, percentage/CGPA and subject.
Qualifying examination (GATE, NET or others): name of the examination, subject, year of passing, score and marks obtained.
Professional / work experience: organisation, designation, start date and end date. You must list at least your current employment.
A declaration that the details are correct, with your name and signature, the date and the place.
important_instructions: Other relevant guidelines of the funding agency (CSTUP) and the GoI rules will be followed. For questions, contact Dr. Priya Ranjan Muduli (Principal Investigator), Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi, Varanasi - 221005 (U.P.) India, email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant (JRA) at a Glance

rows.details: Development of Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Medical Things-based Wearable Cuffless Blood Pressure Monitoring Device for mHealth Applications
Council of Science & Technology U. P. (CSTUP)
Project sanctioned up to Two Years (2025-27). The position is coterminous with the project.
Rs. 28,000/- per month (Fixed Stipend/ Fellowship/ Salary)
Upper age limit 28 years on 1 April 2026 (relaxable as per GoI Rules)
Only Indian citizens who are residents of Uttar Pradesh
Department of Electronics Engineering, IIT (BHU) Varanasi
Email (one PDF file); no hard copy is required

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens who are residents of Uttar Pradesh are eligible for Research Assistantships in this project, because CST-UP funds it. B.E/B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied branches with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade), OR M.Sc. in Electronics, Physics, or allied areas with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade). Candidates with M.Tech or higher qualifications in the relevant discipline will also be considered. A valid GATE qualification in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or a NET qualification in Electronic Science / Physics, or any other national-level eligibility examination in the relevant discipline. A consistently strong academic record with no backlogs at the time of application. The upper age limit is 28 years on 1 April 2026. It is relaxable as per GoI Rules. The notice prints no minimum age. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules. Check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Assistant (JRA) gets a fixed amount of Rs. 28,000/- p.m., which the notice calls a "Stipend/ Fellowship/ Salary". The position is purely temporary and is coterminous with the project, which is sanctioned for up to two years (2025-27). If selected, the candidate is expected to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant (JRA)
content_sections.text: For more information about the project, the notice gives this page: https://iitbhu.ac.in/dept/ece/people/prmuduliece Filled application form All relevant qualification certificates Marksheets Experience certificate Age proof Caste certificate (the form says a certificate must be attached if you are OBC/SC/ST) Any other relevant documents Personal details: name, father's name, mother's name, e-mail, phone number, date of birth, category (GN / OBC / SC / ST), permanent address and correspondence address. Education: for 10th, 12th, B.Tech./B.E./B.Sc., M.Sc. and others, the university/board, year of passing, percentage/CGPA and subject. Qualifying examination (GATE, NET or others): name of the examination, subject, year of passing, score and marks obtained. Professional / work experience: organisation, designation, start date and end date. You must list at least your current employment. A declaration that the details are correct, with your name and signature, the date and the place.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If you are shortlisted, you must show all your original documents at the interview. Shortlisting is based on the data you sent with your application. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Other relevant guidelines of the funding agency (CSTUP) and the GoI rules will be followed. For questions, contact Dr. Priya Ranjan Muduli (Principal Investigator), Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi, Varanasi - 221005 (U.P.) India, email: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT BHU Recruitment 2026 for Junior Research Assistant?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Junior Research Assistant (JRA), in the Department of Electronics Engineering, IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: You must apply within 21 days of the advertisement. The notice does not print a calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: You need a B.E/B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering or allied branches with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade), or an M.Sc. in Electronics, Physics, or allied areas with First Class (≥60% marks or equivalent grade). Candidates with M.Tech or higher qualifications in the relevant discipline will also be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years on 1 April 2026, relaxable as per GoI Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT BHU Junior Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The post pays a fixed Stipend/ Fellowship/ Salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: Only Indian citizens who are residents of Uttar Pradesh can apply, because the project is funded by CST-UP.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: Make one PDF file with the filled application form and all your documents. Email it to [email protected]. No hard copy is required.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should I use in the application email?
faq.answer: Use the subject line "Application for R&D/SA/CSTUP/ECE/25-26/772".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IIT BHU JRA post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. The PI may limit how many are called, based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum. You must show your original documents at the interview, and no TA/DA is paid.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIT BHU JRA job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and is coterminous with the CSTUP-sponsored project, which is sanctioned for up to two years (2025-27).
